_comment: GPU PCI-id -> compatible driver branch(es). Used by install.sh to auto-pick / validate the driver version for the detected GPU, so users never land on an incompatible branch (issue #77 class). 'branches' lists supported major branches, newest-preferred first. Extend as GPUs/branches are validated. 'cuda_max' is the highest CUDA toolkit version that can target this GPU (driver-independent, set by compute capability); 'needs_gsp' marks GPUs that require GSP firmware on 580.

branch_notes.470: Legacy LTSB. Kepler..Ampere (no Ada). Use for older GPUs 535/550 dropped; builds clean on kver5. NVENC/NVDEC present (H.264/HEVC); no AV1. ffmpeg layer is pinned to jellyfin-ffmpeg 5.1.2-9 (NVENC API 11.1) - never pair with the 535/550 ffmpeg (API 12.x, will fail to load). Kepler GPUs: H.264 encode only, no HEVC encode (HEVC encode needs Maxwell 2nd-gen GM206+).
branch_notes.535: Production Branch. Maxwell..Ada. Recommended default for Pascal/Turing (verified: P620).
branch_notes.550: Maxwell..Ada. ffmpeg layer jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.0.2-9 (NVENC SDK 12.0, same pin as 535 - not 12.1). Superseded by 580.
branch_notes.580: Last branch covering Maxwell..Blackwell(RTX 50). Native CUDA 13.0. Raises the usable CUDA ceiling on Pascal from 12.4 (550) to 12.9 - CUDA 13.0 itself needs compute capability >= 7.5 (Turing), so Pascal/Maxwell/Volta stay at 12.9. Turing+ REQUIRES GSP firmware (gsp_*.bin under /lib/firmware/nvidia/<ver>/) - not yet shipped, so 580 is currently validated for pre-Turing only. ffmpeg layer: jellyfin-ffmpeg 7.1.4-3 (NVENC SDK 12.0, needs driver >= 530).
